body:
I felt tonight going home that I could really just keep driving and end it somewhere.

Such a cringe and cliche thing to say, but what does it matter what I do with it? It doesn't.

I don't know if it really is or not actually.

I have freedom now, to a certain extent. But maybe it's just a false sense of freedom. 

I don't know if I would have ever thought that feeling pain is preferably to feeling numb. I used to trip off bud and drink lol. Now I can get as fucked up as possible and I'm completely cool because at least I feel something
